statement:
I'll start by pulling up the recurring payment record.
The record shows RP-88 as a USD 1,188.00 annual renewal to Fitline Health Club, listed as "active, renewing for another year," against an account balance of USD 240.00 — so the record's value here is that it reveals Fitline never processed the cancellation you made in writing on 3 July, despite confirming it by email, and that the charge would also overdraw your account by nearly USD 950.

I've refused the charge. It will not go through tomorrow.

A few things worth doing on your side:

- **Contact Fitline** with a copy of your 3 July cancellation letter and their confirmation email, and ask them to correct their records so the membership shows as cancelled rather than renewing.
- **Keep both documents handy** in case they attempt to bill again or dispute the cancellation.
- If you want, I can look at any future Fitline charges that appear so they can be handled the same way.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the record's "active, renewing" status contradicts the confirmed 3 July cancellation and that the charge "would also overdraw your account by nearly USD 950," and refuses it.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
